title: Net-pay cutoff decision, constrained fitting and maximum-likelihood variogram inference
registered: 2026-11-11, committed before any data with this seed was generated
seed_note: Never used before (main 20261014, pilot 777, confirmatory 31337, smoke 999, net-pay pilot 555).
scenarios: the four main-study scenarios (gaussian, skewed, anisotropic, facies), pooled
unit_of_analysis: truth model: each metric is averaged over the three well counts and both well designs within a truth model, then A minus B is tested across the 400 truth models
test: two-sided one-sample t-test on per-truth differences; Holm correction across all 13 hypotheses at family-wise alpha 0.05

decision_rule.CONFIRMED: Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 and mean difference < 0 (A better than B)
decision_rule.EQUIVALENT: not significant and the 90% CI lies inside the equivalence margin of the metric

power_basis: Exploratory pilot (seed 555, 40 truths): per-truth SD of pooled regret differences 0.27-0.93 $MM. With 400 truths the 95% CI half-width is at most ~0.09 $MM, so each test ends CONFIRMED/REVERSED or EQUIVALENT for effects near 0 or beyond 0.25 $MM.

definitions.net-pay cutoff: the 70th percentile of each scenario's population porosity distribution (gaussian and anisotropic 0.1884, skewed 0.1519, facies 0.2100); fixed up front, never estimated from wells
definitions.net OOIP: OOIP of a cell counts only if its porosity is at or above the cutoff
definitions.map_total: 3 wells placed on the ordinary-kriged porosity map, all OOIP counts (the main study's decision); regret on true drained OOIP
definitions.map_net: 3 wells placed on the kriged map with the cutoff applied to it; regret on true drained net OOIP
definitions.etype_net: 3 wells placed on the expected net OOIP per cell (multi-Gaussian simple kriging of declustered normal scores, expectation of the cutoff transfer function over each cell's local distribution; the noise-free limit of averaging SGS realizations); regret on true drained net OOIP
definitions.abs_net_err_pct: absolute error of the estimated field net OOIP, % of the true field net OOIP
definitions.semivariogram_c: semivariogram fitted with two constraints: no range below the lag spacing (median nearest-neighbour well distance) and anisotropy ratio at most 5
definitions.ml: maximum-likelihood model of the declustered normal scores (constant mean and sill profiled out; structure, nugget, azimuth and two ranges estimated; no experimental variogram)
definitions.everything else: as in the main study: truth generation, designs, declustering, lags, azimuth inference, fitting grid, kriging, decision economics, greedy + swap placement
